primaryPainPoint: Paying legacy software per-barcode scan fees for commercial extinguisher route inspections across Greene County.
customHook: I noticed Ozark Fire handles commercial route inspections across Springfield and Greene County. Most fire contractors I talk to in Missouri are fed up with paying 20¢ to 50¢ every time a tech scans a barcode on BuildingReports.

primaryPainPoint: Time wasted in the truck manually writing paper inspection tags and re-typing deficiency quotes for property managers.
customHook: I know Midwest Fire services high-volume commercial properties across the 417 area. Re-typing field notes and handwritten tags into office invoices wastes hours every Friday.

primaryPainPoint: Restaurant owners and municipal fire inspectors demanding before/after photo proof for bare-metal NFPA 96 compliance.
customHook: Saw your crew cleans restaurant exhaust hoods across Springfield and Branson. Getting restaurant owners and Springfield fire marshals to sign off on duct cleaning is 10x faster when before/after photos are timestamped on an official certificate before the techs leave the kitchen.

primaryPainPoint: Springfield Environmental Services requiring strict 25% FOG sludge depth logs and pump-out manifests.
customHook: With Springfield Environmental Services cracking down on grease trap discharge and 25% rule manifests, keeping pump-out depths on paper tickets is a compliance nightmare for food service clients.

primaryPainPoint: Missing 6-year teardown and 12-year hydrostatic test dates on recurring customer routes.
customHook: Managing recurring annual extinguisher dates plus 6-year teardowns and 12-year hydro schedules across Southwest Missouri usually results in missed service revenue.

primaryPainPoint: Difficulty scheduling recurring quarterly and semi-annual NFPA 96 cleanings automatically.
customHook: Commercial kitchens frequently forget their required quarterly NFPA 96 cleaning until the health inspector shows up. Automated 30-day renewal reminders lock in recurring route contracts effortlessly.
